headline: Supply jumps,
*but not in Chicago*
slides.sub: Listings are up 7.4% nationally and up double digits in most big Midwest metros.
slides.fig_caption: Chicago-area active listings, Oct. 2026 vs. a year ago

slides.title: Inventory vs. *a year ago*
slides.note: Chicago is the only big Midwest metro in the report where active inventory *shrank* from a year ago.

slides.label: Chicago median list price, now *$380,000*
slides.body: The national median list price slipped 2.2% to $415,000. Just 17.6% of Chicago listings had a price cut, vs. 20.5% nationally.

slides.title: A slower, *roomier* market
points: 1,183,500 active listings, up 7.4% from last October
New listings down 7.5% as fewer owners list
Homes under contract down 10.5% year over year
Median 63 days on market, up one day

slides.title: Price to the *local* data
slides.body: National headlines say buyers are gaining leverage. In Chicago, tight supply is still holding prices up. Show clients metro-level numbers, and prepare buyers for competition on well-priced homes.
